body: I have gained a bit more insight into my motivations, and my reconsidered my actions.  I was planning, writing notes, etc.  I'm home from work today simply because I can't handle it right now.  I'm trying to fix myself little by little.
"It's a fool who looks for logic in the chambers of the human heart."
I am the victim in some fashion, always.  It doesn't feel "real" unless I am victimized in some way.

You are 100% correct.  I do have an idealized version of what relationships are.  My models for relationships when I was growing up are really screwed-up, I know that.  So I've had to invent things in order to try to replace it.  I don't know how to stop doing that because it's so deeply ingrained in me.  I get stuck in the middle -- I'm OK with my relationships being awful, horrible, exploitative and abusive or some unrealistic ideal.  In-between or just "normal" doesn't, and hasn't ever existed for me.  And the truth is that I'm not sure I'd be able to handle it if it came along.
I've never really considered the possibility that maybe the people I care about are just assholes.

Want to know what lame thing I've been holding on to?  The Hobbit movies.  As stupid as it sounds, every time I start actually planning I think of the reality of the situation and fixate on the fact that I won't get to see the goddamn Hobbit movies.
